title: Preparation and Use of Turn-on Fluorescent Probe for Detection and Live Cell Imaging of Vitamin D Receptor as a Target Protein
protocol: Weigh 1.01 g of 4-(diethylamino)salicylaldehyde in a 50 mL round-bottom flask containing a magnetic stirring bar.
Add 3.7 mL of anhydrous DMF to the flask.
Slowly add 1.0 g of tert-butyldimethylchlorosilane and 565 mg of imidazole to above flask.
Equip the round-bottom flask with an argon-filled balloon to protect the reaction against moisture.
Stir the solution at room temperature for 24 h.
Cool the reaction mixture to 0°C by using an ice-water cooling bath.
Add 10 mL of distilled water to stop the reaction.
Extract the mixture with ethyl acetate three times in a separatory funnel.
Dry the organic layer with anhydrous magnesium sulfate for 15 min and filter to remove the magnesium sulfate.
Condense the organic layer using the rotary evaporator to afford the crude product.
Slowly add a magnetic stirring bar to a 100 mL two-neck round-bottom flask.
Equip the main neck of the two-neck round-bottom flask with an argon-filled balloon.
Place a rubber septum on remaining side neck of the flask.
Connect the flask to a vacuum pump.
Put the flask under reduced pressure for 10 min and then back-fill the flask with argon.
Using a syringe, add 5.4 mL of anhydrous THF and 0.95 mL of diisopropylamine (6.77 mmol) through the septum on the side neck.
Cool the flask to 0°C by using an ice-water cooling bath.
Using a syringe, add 3.1 mL of 2.0 M n-butyllithium in cyclohexane (6.25 mmol) dropwise to above flask.
Stir the solution at 0°C for 10 min.
Cool the reaction mixture to -78°C by using a dry ice-acetone cooling bath.
Using a syringe, add 3.1 mL of 2.0 M (trimethylsilyl)diazomethane in diethyl ether (6.25 mmol) dropwise to the flask.
Stir the solution at -78°C for 30 min.
Charge a 25 mL two-neck round-bottom flask with a magnetic stirring bar and compound 1.
Equip the main neck of the flask with an argon-filled balloon.
Place a rubber septum on the remaining side neck of the flask.
Connect the flask to a vacuum pump.
Put the flask under reduced pressure for 10 minutes.
Back-fill the flask with argon.
Add 6.1 mL of anhydrous THF to the flask using a syringe.
Stir the solution until compound 1 has dissolved.
Transfer the compound 1 solution dropwise to the reaction flask from step 5 using a syringe.
Allow the reaction mixture to warm to room temperature (15°C–25°C).
Stir the solution for 19 hours.
Add 10 mL of distilled water to stop the reaction.
Extract the mixture with chloroform three times in a separatory funnel to afford the organic layer.
Dry the organic layer with anhydrous sodium sulfate for 15 minutes.
Filter to remove the sodium sulfate.
Condense the organic layer using a rotary evaporator to afford the crude product.
Purify the crude product by NH2 silica gel column chromatography with hexane.
Obtain the pure compound 2 (1.35 g; yield = 85% from 4-(diethylamino)salicylaldehyde).
Characterize the product by NMR spectroscopy (1H NMR and 13C NMR).
Characterize the product by electrospray ionization MS (HRMS, ESI).
Weigh 243 mg of compound 2 (0.80 mmol) in a 50 mL two-neck round-bottom flask containing a magnetic stirring bar.
Equip the main neck of the two-neck round-bottom flask with an argon-filled balloon.
Place a rubber septum on remaining side neck of the flask.
Connect the flask to a vacuum pump.
Put the flask under reduced pressure for 10 min and then back-fill the flask with argon.
Using a syringe, add 3.2 mL of anhydrous THF through the septum on the side neck.
Cool the flask to -78°C by using a dry ice-acetone cooling bath.
Using a syringe, add 0.57 mL of 2.0 M n-butyllithium in cyclohexane (0.88 mmol) dropwise to above flask.
Stir the solution at -78°C for 30 min.
Allow the reaction mixture to warm to 0°C by using an ice-water cooling bath.
Insert a cannula to the septum on the side neck and flush with CO2 for 10 min.
Stir the solution at 0°C for 1.5 h.
Condense the organic layer using the rotary evaporator to afford the crude mixture.
Weigh compound 3 and lithocholic acid derivative in a two-neck round-bottom flask.
Equip the main neck of the flask with an argon-filled balloon.
Place a rubber septum on the remaining side neck of the flask.
Connect the flask to a vacuum pump.
Put the flask under reduced pressure for 10 minutes.
Back-fill the flask with argon.
Add 0.8 mL of anhydrous CH2Cl2 through the septum using a syringe.
Cool the flask to 0°C using an ice-water cooling bath.
Charge a 10 mL two-neck round-bottom flask with a magnetic stirring bar.
Equip the main neck of this flask with an argon-filled balloon.
Place a rubber septum on the remaining side neck of the flask.
Connect the flask to a vacuum pump.
Put the flask under reduced pressure for 10 minutes.
Back-fill the flask with argon.
Add 0.8 mL of anhydrous CH2Cl2 to this flask.
Dissolve N,N′-dicyclohexylcarbodiimide in anhydrous CH2Cl2 using a syringe.
Add the N,N′-dicyclohexylcarbodiimide solution and HCl solution dropwise to the reaction mixture from Step 3.
Add 9.4 mg of 4-dimethylaminopyridine to the flask.
Allow the reaction mixture to warm to room temperature.
Stir the solution for 14 hours.
Weigh 85 mg of compound 5 in a 25 mL two-neck round-bottom flask containing a magnetic stirring bar.
Equip the main neck of the flask with an argon-filled balloon.
Place a rubber septum on remaining side neck of the flask.
Connect the flask to a vacuum pump.
Put the flask under reduced pressure for 10 min and then back-fill the flask with argon.
Using a syringe, add 1.0 mL of anhydrous THF through the septum on the side neck.
Cool the flask to 0°C by using an ice-water cooling bath.
Using a syringe, add 0.2 mL of tetrabutylammonium fluoride (0.2 mmol) dropwise to above flask.
Stir the solution at 0°C for 20 min.
Purify the compound by silica gel column with 3:2 ethyl acetate/hexane eluent.
Characterize the product by NMR spectroscopy and electrospray ionization MS.
Add 0.75 mL of trypsin-EDTA solution to the cells.
Place the cells into the 37°C incubator for 3 min.
Resuspend the cells in 10 mL of culture medium.
Count the number of cells under a microscope using a hemocytometer.
Seed 1 mL of the cell solution containing 1 × 10^5 cells in a 12-well cell culture plate.
Place the plate in an incubator with 5% CO2 at 37°C for 8 h.
Add 100 μL of Opti-MEM, 1 μg of VDR-OFP plasmid and 3 μL of TransIT-LT1 to a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Mix gently and incubate at room temperature (15°C–25°C) for 20 min.
Add the resultant lipoplex dropwise to the cells.
Place the plate in an incubator with 5% CO2 at 37°C for 12 h.
Aspirate the culture medium from the cell culture dish using a vacuum pump.
Rinse the cells once with 1 mL of PBS.
Add 0.1 mL of trypsin-EDTA solution to the cells.
Place the cells into the 37°C incubator for 3 min.
Resuspend the cells in 1 mL of culture medium.
Add 0.3 mL of cell culture medium and 0.2 mL of the cell solution to a poly-L-lysine coated cover slip in a 24-well cell culture plate.
Place the plate in an incubator with 5% CO2 at 37°C for 24 hours.
Treat VDR-OFP expressing cells with LCA-TCC probe 6 at a concentration of 20 μM in 0.5 mL of cell culture medium.
For competitive experiments, treat VDR-OFP expressing cells with both LCA-TCC probe 6 and 1α,25-dihydroxyvitamin D3 at concentrations of 20 μM in 0.5 mL of cell culture medium.
For negative control experiments, treat VDR-OFP untransfected cells with LCA-TCC probe 6 at a concentration of 20 μM in 0.5 mL of cell culture medium.
Place the cells into a 37°C incubator for 8 hours.
Transfer the cover slips to a glass bottom dish filled with DMEM/Ham’s F-12 culture medium.
Take images using fluorescence microscopy.
Culture HeLa cells in a 10-cm cell culture dish containing 10 mL of culture medium in an incubator with 5% CO2 at 37°C.
Aspirate the culture medium from the cell culture dish using a vacuum pump.
Rinse the cells once with 5 mL of PBS.
Add 0.75 mL of trypsin-EDTA solution to the cells.
Place the cells into the 37°C incubator for 3 min.
Resuspend the cells in 10 mL of culture medium.
Count the number of cells under a microscope using a hemocytometer.
Seed 0.5 mL of the cell solution (containing 5 × 10^4 cells) on a poly-L-lysine coated cover slips in a 24-well cell culture plate.
Place the plate in an incubator with 5% CO2 at 37°C for 24 h.
Treat HeLa cells with LCA-TCC probe 6 at a concentration of 20 μM in 0.5 mL of cell culture medium.
Place the cells into the 37°C incubator for 8 h.
Incubate labeled cells with 0.5 mL of cell culture medium containing 250 nM TMRM at 37°C for 30 min.
Rinse each cover slip three times with 0.5 mL of DMEM/Ham’s F-12 culture medium.
Transfer the cover slips to a glass bottom dish filled with DMEM/Ham’s F-12 culture medium.
Take images using confocal microscopy.
